correctness.rationale: Initial selected root/leaf patterns A=(both blue), B=(root only), D=(neither) have weights z²,z,1. Totality prohibits cyclic DBD. White D roots can be forced exactly when each maximal alternating A–D path containing D has an A endpoint; fully alternating even cycles are blocked. A 15-state (previous,current,starting-tag) transfer with explicit local rules counts precisely feasible words except four false persistent-tag cycles on even n. Its exact 15×15 characteristic polynomial is lambda^10[lambda^5−(z+z²)lambda^4−2z²lambda^3+z⁴lambda²+z⁵]; Newton/trace identity yields rational form. Each permitted alternating component has at least as many As as Ds, so size 2a+b=n+a−d≥n; all B realizes n. Independently simulated graph-theoretic total-zero-forcing for every initial subset on n=3..7 and compared all polynomial coefficients against recurrence including even correction; all agreed. Characteristic identity in inspected verification code uses exact integer-polynomial Newton identities, not floating interpolation.
residual_risks: Independent finite tests cannot alone prove infinite quantified claims; analytic premises and structural lemmas reconstructed.
